text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, when I came to
the cafeteria to eat lunch—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's the matter, Oguri?!
For you to sigh during mealtime of all things...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seems it was decided
that I'm getting turned into a plushie.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...What, ain't that a great thing?
Man, I wasted my energy worryin'.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot celebrate unconditionally.
Out of nowhere, they said I need to have my measurements taken by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That is... a problem, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Oho~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Skippin' meals for just one day ain't gonna change nothin'.
Just go as your usual self!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Guh, as my usual self, huh... Then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Like this?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Like what?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what else... That's it.
Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How's this? I believe I managed
a pretty good quick-change time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, what the heck have you even been doing this whole time...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chime rings)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
The student-organized 'Carrotman Show' will begin shortly.
Students participating or planning to spectate,
please gather in front of the outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —! I see, it's over there!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Where are ya goin'?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I beg you!
Please let me put on that costume!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!!
We already asked Pearl-senpai to play the monster!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguriii!!
What in the world are ya doin'?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Please, Tama, tell them too! I need
practice to become a plushie...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Practice... to become a plushie...?
Hold on a second, Oguri. Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. Did ya mix up
a mascot costume with a plush doll?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...They told me they were 'taking measurements,'
so I naturally assumed I would be going inside it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
As if! The only thing goin'
inside a plushie is cotton!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. What a relief.
Then I don't need to practice holding back
to eighty percent full after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumble~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I no longer have to worry about my clothes bulging.
First, I'll take... 30 large bowls!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Th-That's way too much food...!
